propositions: output_mode blanket-forces PromptedOutput when thinking=True based on stale Anthropic 400 rationale (tool_choice x thinking), but measured testing shows native outputConfig + thinking succeeds on current models (sonnet adaptive, haiku budget 2048)
native_structured_output with extended thinking suppresses tool calling, making it safe only for no-tools single-shot paths, not agentic runners that require tool invocation
adding native_output_with_thinking capability field with default False enables gating NativeOutput on measured per-model compatibility while preserving existing behavior
the guard should resolve to NativeOutput only when caps.native_structured_output AND (not thinking OR caps.native_output_with_thinking), replacing the blanket thinking check
